summary.headline: Astronomical Images and Celestial Virtue
summary.text: Discussion of astronomical images, contrasting them with illicit necromantic images and explaining how celestial figures, significators, ascendants, planetary lords, the Moon, the Part of Fortune, triplicities, and elected hours govern images of destruction, love, and profit. The passage concludes by citing a book on such images by Thabit ibn Qurra and describing their relation to the four elements and celestial virtue.
